scientific_integrity: A complete all-parameter mathematical proof and exact standalone finite-field checker are supplied. Finite tests are not infinite proofs, and independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only nonzero nonidentity twists are treated. Sandwich normalization, twisted-code product identities, Gaussian intersection counts and commuting-only idempotent-pair rank distributions are prior ingredients. Equivalent rank-triplet enumerations in older semigroup literature remain a residual risk.
title: Product-rank distribution of idempotents in nontrivially twisted centralizer codes
